segments.text: Priya Sharma: The JWT authentication module is complete and merged. RBAC with admin, member, and viewer roles is fully implemented. The auth task is closed.
Alex Rivera: The authentication token expiry issue has been fixed. The JWT expiry was misconfigured as seconds instead of milliseconds. The fix is deployed.
Nisha Patel: We decided to integrate the Google Meet connector as the first external meeting source. Nisha Patel will own the connector implementation. Target delivery: September 22nd.
Priya Sharma: Rahul Verma and Priya Sharma are jointly responsible for the data retention policy. We decided on a 90-day retention window for meeting transcripts.
